summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — BAB.L +7%, ASM.AS +3%, HLMA.L +3%, AAF.L +2%, PSH.L +2%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (INVP.L -7%, JD.L -5%, FME.DE -5%, ADYEN.AS -5%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: BAB.L (+7.07%) — No confirmed same-day news found for Babcock (BAB.L); the +7% move fits a UK defence-sector rally, as earlier Babcock jumps came on defence-spending news and naval contracts. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: BAB.L is a UK FTSE 100 defence and engineering mid/large-cap, and no strategy includes it. A gap-driven, news-led move like this would also have been missed by momentum and mean-reversion filters.
